title: Prime Loc! 8BR Near Marathon Village | Sleeps 12!
description:
Welcome to our spacious and budget-friendly 5-bedroom apartment, featuring 8 comfortable beds and 2 couches. Located centrally near Marathon Village, you'll be just minutes away from Nashville's top attractions, dining, and entertainment. Perfect for large groups and families, our apartment offers a fully equipped kitchen, free Wi-Fi, and cozy living spaces. Enjoy easy access to downtown, music venues, and local hotspots. Experience the best of Nashville without breaking the bank!

The space
Welcome to our spacious and budget-friendly 5-bedroom Airbnb apartment, featuring 8 comfortable beds, perfect for accommodating large groups or families. Centrally located near Marathon Village, you'll find yourself just minutes away from Nashville's top attractions, dining, and entertainment options. Our apartment provides a cozy and convenient home base with all the amenities you need for a comfortable stay, including a fully equipped kitchen, free Wi-Fi, and ample living space to relax and unwind.

Our location provides the unique advantage of being close to downtown while remaining budget-friendly for our guests. Situated in an up-and-coming area just minutes from vibrant Broadway, our property offers both convenience and affordability.

Nashville, like many larger cities, boasts a diverse population within its downtown, and our neighborhood reflects this diversity. It's a dynamic experience, somewhat similar to the lively atmosphere one might encounter while visiting a larger city. 

Our goal is to ensure that everyone has a safe, positive and enjoyable time while staying with us in Music City. Our team is available throughout your stay should you have any questions or feedback.

Guest access
Entire home
